text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I knew I was right to believe in
you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I don't need a horoscope to tell me
you're my
lucky person, Trainer! Thank
you so, sooo much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
With my lucky plushie in hand, I feel like
I can do
anything!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Not only is it adorable, but I
get the
feeling it has a mystical aura to it
too!
